content: अरेणु {%a.%} .²1 Not dusty; not soiled with dust, not touching the dust (of the earth). .²2 Not earthly, celestial; स तुर्वर्णिर्महाँ अरेणु पास्ये <ls>Rv. 1. 56. 3</ls>. {%n.%} ({@णु@}) What is not dust, the ether. .{@-णुः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) The gods; त्यं चिदश्वं न वाजिनमरेणवो यमत्नत <ls>Rv. 10. 143. 2</ls>.
